name: billfit
description: Deterministic PG&E residential rate comparison and assistance screening inside Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Check PG&E rate fit and assistance eligibility.
interface.longDescription: BillFit imports residential interval usage, calculates supported PG&E plans with versioned official rate data, screens CARE, FERA, and Medical Baseline, and leaves account access or enrollment to the user.
defaultPrompt: Compare my PG&E rate plan using my Green Button file.
Check whether my household may qualify for CARE or FERA.
Tell me what information BillFit still needs from me.
